sloka: बाष्पापिहितकण्ठश्च प्रेक्ष्य रामं यशस्विनम्।आर्येत्येवाथ संक्रुश्य व्याहर्त्तुं नाशकत्तदा ॥ २.९९.३९॥
transliteration: bāṣpāpihitakaṇṭhaśca prekṣya rāmaṁ yaśasvinam।āryetyevātha saṁkruśya vyāharttuṁ nāśakattadā ॥ 2.99.39॥

translations.english: As he beheld the glorious Rama, with his throat choken with tears, he cried out, O Arya (venerable one) and thereafter, was unable to speak any more.
